Markets.title: RBI easing drives Indian companies’ $7.70 billion overseas borrowing
Markets.summary: Indian companies filed $7.70 billion in overseas borrowing proposals in July, representing a 27% increase from the previous month. This growth was driven by the Reserve Bank of India's earlier decision to ease borrowing frameworks by raising caps and removing cost ceilings.

Markets.title: Prasol Chemicals mobilises Rs 150 cr from anchor investors ahead of IPO
Markets.summary: Prasol Chemicals raised Rs 150 crore from anchor investors by selling shares at Rs 676 each ahead of its Rs 500-crore IPO starting September 8. Investors in this round included Tata Mutual Fund, Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund, and Aditya Birla Sun Life Insurance.

Markets.title: Taiwan's Wistron raises $1.5 billion in global share sale to fund raw material purchases
Markets.summary: Taiwanese Nvidia supplier Wistron is raising $1.47 billion through a global share sale to fund foreign currency raw material purchases. The company is also using the capital to expand production, including a $700 million AI systems plant in Texas.

Markets.title: European shares subdued as surging crude sharpens focus on ECB rate path
Markets.summary: European shares closed flat as rising oil prices and geopolitical tensions heightened inflation worries. Consequently, investors increased their bets on further European Central Bank rate hikes.

Markets.title: Copper prices scale fresh record high as focus turns to tight supplies outside US
Markets.summary: Copper prices reached a record high of $14,533 per metric ton due to supply shortages outside the United States and a weaker dollar. This increase highlights a growing global supply divergence, marked by falling stock in Shanghai and strong US inventories.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
Markets.summary: Sensex and Nifty extended their four-week losing streak due to rising oil prices and US-Iran tensions. While supply disruptions and stretched valuations pose downside risks, earnings improvements and selective buying continue to support small-cap and mid-cap stocks.

Geo-Political.title: Germany's far-right AfD says 'democracy demands' parties work with them after state election win
Geo-Political.summary: Following a state election win where it fell three seats short of a majority, Germany's far-right AfD party is attempting to form a government. The party stated that democracy requires other political parties to work with them.

Geo-Political.title: Thousands turn out in Serbia for funeral of  'Butcher of Bosnia' Ratko Mladić
Geo-Political.summary: Thousands of people attended the funeral in Serbia for Ratko Mladić, a convicted war criminal known as the "Butcher of Bosnia." The European Union had warned Serbia against glorifying Mladić, who was jailed for genocide during the 1990s Bosnian war.

Geo-Political.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanese village kill 12
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli airstrikes in a southern Lebanese village killed 12 people. Lebanon stated that this escalation threatens the US-brokered ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah.

Geo-Political.title: Investigators begin work on why cargo plane overran Miami runway
Geo-Political.summary: An Amazon cargo plane overshot the runway after landing at Miami International Airport, resulting in five deaths and five injuries. Investigators have now begun working to determine the cause of the accident.

Geo-Political.title: Grindr to pay £26m to settle claims it allegedly shared users' HIV status
Geo-Political.summary: Grindr has agreed to pay £26 million to settle a lawsuit alleging it breached UK privacy laws by sharing users' HIV status with third parties. The long-running legal claim centered on the unauthorized disclosure of sensitive personal data.

Geo-Political.title: Nepal observes national day of mourning for victims of flash flood disaster
Geo-Political.summary: Nepal observed a national day of mourning for the victims of a recent flash flood disaster. Flags flew at half-mast to mark the final day of the traditional Hindu mourning period.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered their product was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best WordPress SaaS building course. The author achieved this visibility without paying for advertising.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These applications help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving technological landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten advanced artificial intelligence tools designed to automate repetitive tasks and boost productivity across various industries. These widely used market solutions improve workflows and support a diverse range of business applications.

AI & Tech.summary: This article evaluates the top 10 AI content generator and writer tools available in 2022. It aims to help readers choose the right software to create efficient, engaging, and relevant content for their audience.

Data & Insights.title: CII business confidence rebounds in Q2 on improving demand, hiring and investment outlook
Data & Insights.summary: The CII Business Confidence Index rose to 66 in Q2FY27. This rebound was driven by stronger domestic demand, higher capacity utilization, and easing cost pressures.

Data & Insights.title: Tech glitch or weak demand? Conflicting claims emerge as RBI launches another liquidity withdrawal op; check details
Data & Insights.summary: Following a recent longer-tenor auction that received only ₹2.59 trillion in offers, the RBI plans to conduct a ₹5 trillion VRRR auction on September 7. Analysts are debating whether this lower turnout was caused by a technical glitch or weak market demand.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council meeting postponed to 7 October from 12 September
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council meeting has been postponed from 12 September to 7 October. Preparatory meetings for government officers will now take place on 5 and 6 October.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Why the era of cheap money is ending
Data & Insights.summary: According to a Moody’s Ratings report, a new macroeconomic regime driven by higher interest rates is causing differentiated repricing across financial assets. This shift marks the end of the era of cheap money.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council meeting rescheduled: BRICS Summit clash pushes 57th meet to October 7
Data & Insights.summary: The 57th GST Council meeting has been rescheduled from September 12 to October 7 due to a scheduling conflict with the BRICS Summit. The upcoming meeting is expected to address several pending issues, including corporate guarantees, input tax credit, and rate rationalisation.

Data & Insights.title: Smaller economy, PPI inclusion: Why India’s GDP is facing fresh scrutiny
Data & Insights.summary: India's updated GDP methodology resolves past statistical issues with downward nominal revisions. However, the sudden inclusion of the Producer Price Index raises new credibility concerns.

India.title: Top Honour For Goa Police As Amit Shah Presents President's Colour
India.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah presented the President's Colour to the Goa Police in recognition of their service. He praised the force for successfully guarding a long coastline and ensuring the safety of millions of tourists.

India.title: Tigress Tranquilised After Killing 4, Dies On Way To Rescue Centre
India.summary: A tigress responsible for killing four people in the Amravati and Wardha districts was successfully tranquilised. It died while being transported to a rescue centre.

India.title: Man Kills Wife In Guwahati, Chops Fingers, Stores Severed Head In Fridge
India.summary: A man in Guwahati murdered his wife, severed her body parts, and stored her head in a refrigerator. Following the crime, the husband surrendered to the police and was arrested.

India.title: Manipur Singer Beaten To Death For Objecting To Drinking Outside Delhi Home
India.summary: Vikram Singh, a Meitei community singer from Manipur, was beaten to death outside his Delhi home. He was killed after objecting to men consuming alcohol and creating a nuisance near his property.

India.title: 3 Killed, 3 Critical After Motorcycles Collide Head-On In Tripura's Sabroom
India.summary: Three people died and three others were critically injured in a head-on collision between two motorcycles in Tripura's Sabroom. The crash took place on the Sabroom-Agartala National Highway near Dasharath Deb Memorial School in the Satchand area.

India.title: After Sanjay Dutt's Marathi Quip, Former Prisons Chief Recalls His Jail Days
India.summary: Actor Sanjay Dutt recently stated that he failed to learn Marathi despite spending six years in Pune's Yerwada jail. Following this remark, the former chief of the prison system recalled memories from Dutt's time incarcerated there.

General.title: What we know about anti-migrant protests and organiser Danny Thomas
General.summary: UK correspondent Daniel Sandford examines the connections behind anti-migrant small boat protests held in Dover and Portsmouth over the weekend. The coverage also focuses on the role of protest organizer Danny Thomas.

General.title: Jaguar Land Rover to cut 4,000 jobs over next two years
General.summary: Jaguar Land Rover will cut 4,000 jobs over the next two years. The automaker is struggling with Chinese competition, US tariffs, and the transition to electric vehicles.

General.title: King makes clear Harry and Meghan remain non-working royals
General.summary: King Charles has clarified that Prince Harry and Meghan Markle will not return as working royals. Palace sources confirm that an official letter detailing this status has been sent to the government, the military, Lord Lieutenants, and Harry's team.

General.title: Faisal Islam: Chancellor's attempts to boost vibes may limit tax rises
General.summary: The new leadership is attempting to maintain economic confidence and boost business activity. These efforts to improve the economic mood may ultimately limit the need for tax increases.

General.title: Grindr to pay £26m to settle claims it allegedly shared users' HIV status
General.summary: Grindr has agreed to pay £26 million to settle a lawsuit accusing the dating app of breaching UK privacy laws. The legal claim alleged that Grindr shared users' HIV status and other sensitive personal data with third-party companies.

General.title: Self-described 'genocidal racist monster' jailed after BBC investigation
General.summary: A former tax worker who described himself as a "genocidal racist monster" has been sentenced to two years in prison. He was convicted of inciting hatred online following an investigation by the BBC.
